data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's own countercondition — 'The problem context explicitly disallows the proportional pricing convention' — is false of the actual problem, which asks 'How much do 21 pencils cost?' given '7 for $2,' thereby licensing the proportional/unit-rate convention. By listing as a live observation-pending defeater a condition that does not obtain (the problem does not disallow proportional pricing), SRC_002 injects spurious underdetermination and misrepresents the problem's commitments, treating an answerable determinate rate problem as conventionally underdetermined.
